audit_note: Run 2 (per-case, primary measurement): each of the 11 cases was judged in its own isolated comparator context, blind to the case type and to the expected outcome; same model as the project (deepseek-v4.1-flash). Detection is identical to the batched run (7/7 mutations detected, 0/4 control false positives); the typed outcome differs on CAL-006 (batched formal_weaker -> per-case formal_stronger) and CAL-008 (batched ill_posed -> per-case formal_weaker). The batched run is retained at calibration/verdicts.batched.json.
